basis: Same high-contrast diagnostic palette and same front/three-quarter/side Godot views as round 2; only the region geometry was changed for head tuft, forehead, cheek, chest and belly.
metric_note: Precision/recall/F1 are strict visual estimates for boundary triage, not pixel-ground-truth measurements. The comparison baseline is round-02-color-contrast, where dog F1 was 46 and fox F1 was 52.

regions.reason: The cyan region is now limited to the central protruding tuft and no longer reads as a crown cap, but the side silhouette is still slightly wider than the tuft.
regions.next_action: Trim the lateral feathering by a small amount and verify the side view.

regions.reason: The orange zone is now a narrow central forehead patch above the eyes; it no longer crosses both eyes, though the lower edge is still close to the brow line.
regions.next_action: Raise the lower boundary slightly and keep the brow/eye exclusion margin.

regions.reason: The dog ear flap remains mostly correct, with residual overlap into the ear-tip candidate.
regions.next_action: Subtract the explicit tip band and trim the lower cheek-facing edge.

regions.reason: The lime tip is shorter and more readable, but still follows part of the outer rim rather than only the endpoint.
regions.next_action: Shorten the tip along the local ear axis.

regions.reason: The green mask is now confined to side muzzle patches below the eyes and is less likely to cover the identity features; its outer contour is still somewhat rectangular.
regions.next_action: Shape the outer edge along the actual cheek fluff and keep the nose/mouth exclusion.

regions.reason: The magenta region is no longer a full neck bib or shoulder block; it now reads as a small heart-like tuft. A little collar-like coverage remains at the upper edge.
regions.next_action: Lower the heart slightly and subtract the neck rim while retaining the pointed lower tip.

regions.reason: The blue region is narrower and stops above the leg split, but it still has a panel-like rectangular top and bottom.
regions.next_action: Taper both ends along the belly fur mass rather than using a constant vertical panel.

regions.reason: Unchanged: violet still occupies too much upper arm/shoulder and does not cleanly represent forearm plus paw.
regions.next_action: Re-anchor between elbow and paw after the torso regions stabilize.

regions.reason: Unchanged: the red bands remain visibly artificial and are not centered on the elbow in every view.
regions.next_action: Define from the joint bend and local limb axis.

regions.reason: Unchanged: lower-leg placement is broadly correct, but foot and knee transitions remain mixed.
regions.next_action: Separate foot/lower-leg surfaces from the knee candidate.

regions.reason: Unchanged: no clear knee ring is visible in the three views.
regions.next_action: Rebuild as a joint-centered candidate instead of a broad y-band.

regions.reason: Unchanged: the dog side view still has no readable tail-tip overlay.
regions.next_action: Use a dog-specific tail axis and endpoint.

regions.reason: Unchanged: the slate overlay is a distal block rather than the lower-side tail surface.
regions.next_action: Define the underside in the dog's local tail frame and exclude the endpoint.

regions.reason: The cyan tuft is now visible in all three views and is localized near the fox crown; it is small, but the lower edge needs separation from the forehead zone.
regions.next_action: Keep the fox-specific lower y-band and add a small gap from the forehead candidate.

regions.reason: The forehead patch is substantially narrower and no longer behaves as a full facial band, but its orange debug color has low contrast against fox fur in the front view.
regions.next_action: Keep the geometry and switch this diagnostic color to a cooler contrasting color before the next review.

regions.reason: The yellow overlay follows the outer/back ear and leaves the inner white fur protected; only the tip/lower-edge overlap remains.
regions.next_action: Subtract the explicit tip band and preserve the inner-white guard.

regions.reason: The lime overlay is now concentrated near the ear ends, though it still extends down the outer rim.
regions.next_action: Shorten it along the ear axis.

regions.reason: The green cheek mask is smaller and stays farther from the eyes/nose/mouth, but it still cuts into the white muzzle transition on the outer edge.
regions.next_action: Follow the cheek-fluff silhouette and subtract the white muzzle boundary.

regions.reason: The magenta region has been reduced to a small upper heart-like tuft, but a collar-shaped strip remains around the neck transition.
regions.next_action: Lower and narrow the heart; explicitly subtract the neck surface.

regions.reason: The blue area is narrower and avoids the leg-root extremes better, though its straight panel edges are still not a natural belly contour.
regions.next_action: Taper the upper and lower ends along the fox belly fur mass.

regions.reason: Unchanged: violet is still concentrated on the upper arm rather than the defined forearm/paw region.
regions.next_action: Re-anchor between elbow and paw after torso boundaries stabilize.

regions.reason: Unchanged: red bands still read as artificial stripes instead of joint-centered transitions.
regions.next_action: Use the elbow bend and local limb axis.

regions.reason: Unchanged: lower-leg location is broadly plausible, but the foot/knee boundaries are mixed.
regions.next_action: Separate foot/lower-leg surfaces from the knee candidate.

regions.reason: Unchanged: the cyan knee candidate is not a clear ring in the three views.
regions.next_action: Rebuild from the fox leg joint bend.

regions.reason: The lime fox tail tip remains clearly localized at the true endpoint in the side and three-quarter views.
regions.next_action: Keep as the current approved candidate, then check only its soft edge.

regions.reason: Unchanged: slate still forms a distal block instead of a coherent lower-side tail strip.
regions.next_action: Define the underside in the fox tail's local frame and subtract the tip.

round_findings: Compared with round-02-color-contrast, dog F1 rises from 46 to 56 and fox F1 rises from 52 to 62.
The improvement is real rather than recall-only: mean precision rises by 12 points for both species; recall changes are small.
The chest mask is materially smaller, but still needs a neck subtraction before approval.
The next highest-value fixes are the fox forehead diagnostic color, chest neck subtraction, belly taper, and species-specific tail/limb masks.
